semantics.any: At least one listed tag must be offered; an empty list imposes no any requirement.
semantics.all: Every listed tag must be offered.
semantics.none: No listed tag may be offered.
semantics.scope: tile_ids contains semantic candidates across every registered library and style. preferred_tile_ids is the same-style visual subset; style never blocks semantic compatibility. Qualified IDs use library_id::asset_id.
semantics.exclude_self: When attachment.exclude_self is true, remove only library_id::canonical_asset_id for the queried asset (fall back to object_id, then id). Shared group candidates may include that identity; other group members remain compatible.
semantics.limits: Editorial semantic compatibility only. Does not change or certify walkability, collision, footprint, load bearing, scene geometry, or gameplay.
